title: Did the Dodd-Frank Whistleblower Provision Deter Accounting Fraud

scopes.description: Complete as-downloaded author Stata workflow: Compustat and 13F/fund/FCA panel preparation, all sample construction and required merges, Dodd–Frank 2008–2014 and 2009–2013 analyses, state-FCA 2007–2010 analyses, Tables 3–9, and Figure 1. The supplied identifier workbook does not provide the required analysis panel.

requirements.description: Compustat annual company/fiscal-year source used to construct the F-score, controls, identifiers and growth/rolling variables.

routes.description: Local COMP.FUNDA is the catalogued annual financial candidate and its exact one-row Python probe is readable for the listed annual fields. The exact registered COMP.COMPANY candidate and one-row probe also supply gvkey, cik, loc, state, sic and fyrc, so those fields are not absent from the Compustat catalog as a whole. COMPANY labels loc/state/sic/fyrc as current company-level attributes; the documented join and whether these values match the author's annual construction are unresolved. FUNDA's historical numeric SICH is distinct from COMPANY's current SIC field. Neither candidate establishes the required annual history, author normalization into compustat.dta, or population coverage; the 2007–2014 sample alone does not prove coverage.
routes.expected_period: The datasheet describes a 2007–2014 source/sample period; code constructs lagged/differenced and three-year rolling variables before its 2007–2014 sample restriction. Exact source history needed for those authored operations is unresolved; no arbitrary extra lag years are imposed.

requirements.description: December Thomson Reuters 13F fund holdings used for lagged portfolio ownership and fund/state exposure; code-level fields include CUSIP, manager ID/name, filing date, price and shares.

routes.description: TFN.S34 is the catalogued Thomson-Reuters 13F Holdings candidate with the code's general filing/manager/security/holding measures in its catalog metadata. The permitted one-row Python reader timed out at 15 seconds; it was not retried. The author-specific statefund.dta target population, 22-state manager selection and period coverage are not verified by the catalog candidate.

State FCA table in StateFCA_table.xlsx, sheet BR_stata, including state, passage year, false-claims category and qui-tam flag. The workbook is absent; the datasheet names the cited state FCA sources but does not provide the BR_stata worksheet data or its exact source mapping.

InstitutionOwn.dta with date, CUSIP and institutional ownership percentage; exact upstream product/table mapping is unspecified. The frozen catalog literal filename lookup for InstitutionOwn returned no candidate; the datasheet names 13F at a broad product level, but no supplied route maps that product to this prepared instown_perc file.

requirements.description: Audit Analytics audit-fee export fund_auditfees.dta matched on CIK/fiscal year, with audit_fees.

routes.description: The local Audit Analytics FEED03 audit-fees candidate is readable for one row and contains COMPANY_FKEY, FISCAL_YEAR, FISCAL_YEAR_ENDED and AUDIT_FEES. The official WRDS product page identifies schema `audit_audit_comp` and links its data dictionary, but the public dictionary redirects to login; this check does not resolve COMPANY_FKEY meaning or fiscal-year semantics and does not establish a data-license barrier. The author consumer joins fund_auditfees.dta by CIK and fyear, and its producer/normalization is not supplied. Keep the route unverified pending its exact key/year and producer contract.

routes.description: The local Audit Analytics FEED11 SOX 404 internal-controls candidate is readable for one row and contains COMPANY_FKEY, FY_IC_OP, SIG_DATE_IC_OP and COUNT_WEAK. The official WRDS dictionary for schema `audit_audit_comp` redirects to login, so the public static check does not resolve COMPANY_FKEY or fiscal-year definitions and does not establish a data-license barrier. `FY_IC_OP` is the catalog field label for an IC-opinion fiscal year; equivalence to author fyear, construction of sig_date_ic_op_x, and the fund_icw.dta producer remain unresolved. Keep the route unverified pending those exact contracts.

issues.description: Line 199 writes fundlevel.dta under $main/working, but line 204 reads the same basename from an unrelated absolute RR/Round2/data path. Stage the exact line-199 output at the consumer path or use that produced working file consistently.

The Figure 1 code imports working/coefficient.xlsx (Fscore) after estimating a model, but the supplied source contains no save/export producer or supported mapping of coefficient estimates into year/coeff/lci/uci.

The package lacks several author-required raw/source, lookup and prepared inputs. Frozen-catalog checks identified COMP.FUNDA and COMP.COMPANY, Thomson Reuters 13F, Compustat segments and Audit Analytics candidates; bounded one-row checks were readable except the single 13F timeout. Catalog and sampled fields do not establish the required author-specific population, period, history, key mappings or producer contracts, and several prepared files have no verified route. The datasheet's broad public-availability wording does not establish free commercial access; already-readable local candidates are not classified as license-blocked and no new entitlement attestation is required for them.

The COMP.FUNDA candidate contains the annual financial fields used by the do-file. A separate exact COMP.COMPANY catalog entry and one-row probe expose gvkey, loc, state, sic and fyrc; these are labeled current company-level fields, while FUNDA's SICH is numeric and explicitly historical. The documented COMPANY-to-FUNDA join, temporal role in the author panel, any required annual mappings, and the complete compustat.dta producer remain unresolved. Do not equate current SIC with historical SICH or treat COMPANY as an annual panel.

The code consumes fund_segment.dta with CUSIP/fyear/N_seg, while the local Compustat segment candidate exposes gvkey/segment identifiers/dates. No supplied producer, type filter, key/date mapping or N_seg definition establishes compatibility.

FEED03 is locally readable with COMPANY_FKEY, FISCAL_YEAR, FISCAL_YEAR_ENDED and AUDIT_FEES. The public WRDS dictionary check did not expose field definitions, so it establishes neither that COMPANY_FKEY is CIK nor that a separate crosswalk is needed, and it does not resolve FISCAL_YEAR-to-fyear semantics. The author fund_auditfees.dta producer and normalization remain absent.

FEED11 is locally readable with COMPANY_FKEY, FY_IC_OP, SIG_DATE_IC_OP and COUNT_WEAK. The public WRDS dictionary check did not disclose field definitions; do not assume COMPANY_FKEY is or is not CIK, and do not equate FY_IC_OP with author fyear without documentation. The `sig_date_ic_op_x` suffix, the ordered `drop sig_date_ic_op_x- _merge` field range, and the fund_icw.dta producer remain unresolved.

InstitutionOwn.dta is required for instown_perc and matched by CUSIP/fyear, but its upstream product, source field, ownership denominator, history and producer are unspecified. A 13F catalog candidate is not assumed to produce this measure.

The do-file executes `ssc inst diff, replace` before its diff calls. That line would install a package at run time; this audit did not execute it. The required diff command is not found by Stata 18 in the checked default adopath.

The driver hard-codes Windows-specific Data and Tables roots. A working-copy root and matching relative Data/rawdata, Data/working and Tables directories need to be configured before the complete workflow can run on the assigned host.

The supplied Stata source has 31 active `use ...,replace` calls. The official `use` syntax lists `clear` and `nolabel`, and documents `clear` as the option for replacing unsaved in-memory data. A same-operation `replace`-to-`clear` working-copy correction is supported at all 31 calls; no syntax trial or author-approval gate is needed.

review_notes: This assessment covers the complete supplied BL_Final_Code.do workflow, including the Dodd–Frank and state FCA branches, Tables 3–9 and Figure 1. BL_Identifiers.xlsx is a CUSIP identifier list, not an analysis panel; no analysis-only scope is supported.

All 14 frozen dependency checklist IDs are reviewed. Same-run intermediates and tempfiles are distinguished from external/prepared inputs; the additional unlisted segment, audit-fee and ICW reads are covered by explicit requirements and unresolved producer/key issues.

Frozen-catalog candidates and one-row local probes establish only candidate identity/readability and sampled columns. COMP.COMPANY provides current company-level loc/state/sic/fyrc alongside the separate COMP.FUNDA annual financial candidate; the join and annual temporal contract remain unresolved. TFN.S34 timed out once at 15 seconds and was not retried. Neither failed probes, empty filename matches nor the datasheet's broad public-availability statement establish data absence, license denial or free commercial access.

Stata 18 version/which metadata covers every active add-on and the egen `_gnvals` entry point. Six commands were not found in the checked default adopath; no packages were installed, and no author code, syntax, estimator or empirical data were run. Historical SAS startup attempts are present in the inherited environment record but were not repeated for this assignment.

Administrative helper history is retained under probes/: the first checkpoint-03 launch used a relative path from the git cwd; the initial source-quote update used the wrong file for datasheet quotations; and preflight v1 treated an omitted optional patch_proposal field as null. Each stopped before changing the submitted draft; corrected invocations and their separate logs/status records are preserved. These process records are not scientific evidence.

The proposed path edits are for a separate working copy and use relative Data and Tables roots. The fundlevel consumer is redirected to its exact same-run producer. Scientific input contracts, the Figure 1 workbook producer and specific data-construction contracts remain unresolved; no blanket entitlement precondition is imposed on already-readable local candidates; the proposed run procedure preserves all source branches and authored methods.

A bounded official WRDS check confirmed the Audit Analytics schema listing but its public data-dictionary link redirects to login, leaving COMPANY_FKEY and fiscal-year definitions unresolved; this is only a public metadata-viewing limit. The official Stata use manual supports replacing all 31 active `use ...,replace` options with `clear` in a separate working copy, with line 387 combined into the existing path edit. No author code or syntax was run.
